title: Abraham's Faith and Righteousness
description: Paul uses Abraham as the main example that righteousness is credited through faith and not by works. Abraham believed God before his circumcision, and he did not waver in faith regarding the promise of a great offspring, even though he was nearly a hundred years old and Sarah's womb was dead. In this way, he became the father of all who believe, and the same is credited to us who believe in him who raised Jesus from the dead.
